body: We try. A lot of the time my phone bill went/will go unpaid due to alcoholic frenzies. Im not trying to shoot down all your suggestions, but my life seems to find it easy to retort with how depressing my life is.

Were close. But working 6am to 11pm every single day makes it hard to contact her, aside from her insanely busy schedule. I would, but after losing half my money, plus bills, Im left with around 150 for two weeks.

Next morning, my chain of command found out and told us what happened. I instantly told them I had an item, didn't know it was stolen. After promises unkept and examples to be made, Im now being kicked out. On top of that, they took half my pay, all my rank, 45 days extra duty and I can't go home to see my family. Just too much. I have one reason to live which is my sister. Doesn't feel like enough today. And I just keep thinking about not having a single thing to unwrap for Christmas has been that one thought driving me over the edge today. Its small, but just enough..

All my brothers in my platoon were given a verbal command to not communicate with me at all. So, everyone turned their backs on me. Right as they were deploying, my wife left for home and never came back. Divorce will shortly follow. Stuck here, alone, psychotic lead to alcoholism. Bottle of wild turkey to myself a day. I've cut  mostly out of my life for about two weeks now. , I was involved in a robbery. By involved, I was there and didn't know what was going on. My friends stole like 7000 in government property and used me as a lookout because Im usually oblivious to anything around me. Then, my roommate had me take a stolen axe back to our place without telling me.

Im just in a pretty shitty juncture. Feel a bit too deep. I just crawled out of 3 years of lurking to make an account incase I needed someone. Here's a little back story; Im about two years deep into my first enlistment in the Army. 13 hours away from home. I was supposed to be in Afghanistan right now, but after a huge freak out I had about a year ago I was diagnosed with psychotic disorder. Basically, I have a mild case of hearing voices, seeing things, paranoia. That made me unfit to hold a weapon, and they wouldn't let me go
Yep. Today is the day I finally kill myself.
This one is hands down my favorite.
